title: Leadership as Coordination Control: Behavioral Signatures and the Recovery-Advantage Boundary in Multi-Agent LLM Teams
abstract: arXiv:2606.19111v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Team science holds that leadership is contingent: it helps only under specific conditions. We ask the same question of multi-agent LLM teams: under what measurable conditions does process-level coordination control add value, and do those conditions match what team science predicts? This takes measurement, not just accuracy: we use behavioral signatures (majority lock-in, exploration, recovery from an incorrect round-0 consensus) and per-action ablations, clean because each controller is an explicit action set. We operationalize three classical leadership styles (transactional, transformational, situational) as controllers over a shared action vocabulary (explore, revise, accept, synthesize). A matched controller with the same actions but an arbitrary rule recovers no better than majority voting. translated_title: 作为协调控制的领导力：多智能体LLM团队中的行为特征与恢复优势边界
translated_abstract: 团队科学认为领导力是权变的：它只在特定条件下才发挥作用。我们对多智能体LLM团队提出同样的问题：在哪些可测量的条件下，过程级协调控制能够带来价值？这些条件是否符合团队科学的预测？这需要的是测量，而不仅仅是准确率：我们使用行为特征（多数锁定、探索、从错误的第0轮共识中恢复）以及逐动作消融实验，由于每个控制器都是显式的动作集合，因此实验设计是干净的。我们将三种经典领导风格（交易型、变革型、情境型）操作化为共享动作词汇表（探索、修改、接受、综合）之上的控制器。一个使用相同动作但规则随机的匹配控制器，其恢复表现并不优于多数投票。在四种任务情境和三个开源权重模型家族上，没有任何控制器在准确率上占据主导地位。交易型控制……（摘要此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究将交易型、变革型、情境型三种经典领导风格操作化为多智能体LLM团队中的过程级协调控制器，并通过行为特征测量发现：没有任何控制器在准确率上全面占优，其价值取决于特定条件，且从错误共识中恢复的优势存在明确边界。
en_tdlr: This study operationalizes three classical leadership styles (transactional, transformational, situational) as process-level coordination controllers in multi-agent LLM teams, finding via behavioral signatures that no controller dominates in accuracy—leadership value is contingent and bounded by a recovery-advantage boundary.
